name: Once Saved Always Saved
overview: The doctrine of 'Once Saved Always Saved' is examined through Scripture which emphasizes both the assurance and responsibility of the believer. John 3:16 promises everlasting life to those who believe in Christ, while John 10:27 affirms the intimate relationship between Jesus and His sheep who hear and follow Him. However, passages such as Matthew 7:21 and Hebrews 10:26 warn that claiming Christ without doing the Father's will or willfully sinning after knowing the truth carries serious consequences. Hebrews 6:4 highlights the gravity of falling away after enlightenment, and James 5:19 encourages restoration for those who err from the truth, underscoring the ongoing call to perseverance in faith.
